checks: Existing staff credential reads one real prepared aggregate bundle without operational fanout
Seven normal-origin UI assets exactly match the frozen accepted image sources
Idle view makes no API requests; explicit Refresh performs one bounded prepared query
Actual aggregate dashboards fit 1440, 1280 and 390 pixel widths
Daily unknowns and exact-day immature or unavailable cells match the actual API response
Genuine precollection query stays unknown rather than creating zero activity, journeys or Store outcomes
Observed Store and social events retain their meaning; no verified payment or client history is invented
Lock clears the aggregate view and credential; no stored credentials, API writes or browser exceptions

actual_coverage.scope: Signed-in players only, including artificial players; qualified foreground observations and authoritative accepted results/publications.
limitations: Guest coverage is unavailable; no guest/account linking is performed.
Client finishes are observations; only server race_accepted facts increment accepted races.
Counts are prepared snapshots; processor lag and the current partial day remain visible.
First-race cohorts wait 24 hours plus 10 minutes for a second start; creator cohorts wait seven days. Profiles retain at most 128 ordered milestones; unresolved overflow is scoped to its cohort.
Raw observations are bounded; retained facts cover 180 days. Earlier or unavailable coverage is not zero.
Event counts describe observed offers/actions; exposure comparisons do not establish causal preference.
Loss counters are client-reported per-player maxima; shared installations/account changes can overlap these reports.
